title: Font Manager Unicode character names
description: The Name property of every named code point, copied from UnicodeData.txt of the Unicode Character Database. The glyph detail shows it (LATIN SMALL LETTER G).

unicodeVersion.description: The Unicode version the names come from (17.0.0).

source.description: The URL of the UnicodeData.txt file the names were copied from.

ranges.description: Ranges whose names are derived from the code point, sorted, not overlapping: a prefix and the code point in hex (CJK UNIFIED IDEOGRAPH-4E00), or the Hangul syllable rule of the Unicode Standard, section 3.12.

names.description: Code point in hex → name, for every other named code point. Controls, surrogates and private use have no name.

codePoint.description: A code point in upper-case hex, 4 to 6 digits, at most 10FFFF.
